title.narrative: Investing Towards Impact for HIV and AIDS in South Sudan - South Sudan (01-Oct-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: South Sudan, HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP South Sudan)This program has the following goals: To reduce mortality among men, women and children living with HIV by 50% by 2017. To reduce new adult HIV infections by 50% by 2017. The objectives of this program are: To create a sustainable, enabling environment for intensified HIV prevention, treatment, care and management. To increase access to and improve quality of HIV care, treatment, treatment as prevention and TB/HIV collaboration across key, general and humanitarian populations. To intensify HIV prevention efforts across key populations, vulnerable populations and populations of humanitarian concern
